nuggets.text: The Green Wave were the first opponent ever at South Alabama's Hancock Whitney Stadium, on Sept. 12, 2020.
Green Wave coach Will Hall won the 2003 Harlon Hill Trophy as Division II's top player at North Alabama.
Will Hall set a junior college record with 4,075 total yards at Northwest Mississippi CC in 2000.
Will Hall was once the Green Wave's offensive coordinator before coming back as head coach this season.
The Green Wave won the very first Sugar Bowl, beating Temple 20-14 in 1935.
The Green Wave's mascot is Riptide the Pelican; before 1998 it was an angry wave that fans nicknamed Gumby.
A 3,353-pound Angry Wave sculpture that doubles as a water feature sits atop Yulman Stadium's scoreboard.
Yulman Stadium is named for former Serta chairman Richard Yulman, who with his wife gave $15 million to build it.
Yulman Stadium's first game, against Georgia Tech in 2014, sold out in 14 minutes.
The Green Wave won the 2025 American Conference title and reached the 12-team College Football Playoff.
